## Claims
- [source-backed] Case-insensitive fixed-substring audit count: `conjecture` has 9 hits, at lines 202, 206, 938, 942, 945, 947, 955, 978, 1247. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 202-206]
- [source-backed] L202: “we conjecture” informally asserts minimality of the smaller type-\(A\) generating set for \(J_v\); no additional hypotheses occur there. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 202-205]
- [source-backed] L206: “minimality conjecture” is cited for the conditional consequence that, if true, it gives an exponential lower bound on generators for \(I_w\) in type \(A\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 206-211]
- [source-backed] L938 is the section heading “A minimality conjecture”; it states no separate assertion or hypotheses. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-941]
- [source-backed] L942, “Conjecture 4.10,” asserts: for a type-\(A\) bigrassmannian \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\), both Theorem 4.8 families
  \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\) and
  \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\)
  minimally generate \(J_v\), where \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\) and \(b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 864-876; 938-946]
- [source-backed] L945, “this conjecture,” reports finite computer verification only for bigrassmannian permutations with \(r\le4\) and \(n-r\le5\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 942-946]
- [source-backed] L947, “Conjecture 4.10,” invokes the same conditional minimality assertion for \(n=4m\), \(r=n-r=2m\), \(i=j=m\), hence \(a=b=m\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 947-955]
- [source-backed] L955, “according to Conjecture 4.10,” gives the conditional generator count \(\binom{2m}{m}\sim4^m/\sqrt{\pi m}=\sqrt2^{\,n+2}/\sqrt{\pi n}\) under the preceding \(m\ge1\) specialization. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 950-955]
- [source-backed] L978, “we have conjectured,” repeats the minimality claim for the Theorem 4.8 families while explaining that their concatenation for \(I_w=\sum_{v\in\mathcal E(w)}J_v\) need not be minimal. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 977-994]
- [source-backed] L1247 contains the bibliographic title “a conjecture of Postnikov”; no assertion or hypotheses of that conjecture are given. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1245-1248]
- [source-backed] Case-insensitive fixed-substring audit count: `question` has 3 hits, at lines 104, 1143, 1144. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 104-106; 1143-1145]
- [source-backed] L104 says that finding simple presentations of \(I_w\) for root systems other than type \(A\) “appears to have been less studied”; it is commentary, not a formally posed question. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 104-106]
- [source-backed] L1143 is the heading “A question,” with no standalone assertion or hypotheses. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1143-1144]
- [source-backed] L1144, “Question 5.1,” asks for a minimal generating set of \(I_w\) in type \(A_{n-1}\), at least for \(n^2\)-generated subclasses: inclusion-defined \(X_w\) avoiding \(\{4231,35142,42513,351624\}\), or smooth \(X_w\) avoiding \(\{3412,4231\}\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1144-1161]
- [source-backed] The fixed-string counts for `problem`, `we ask`, and `remains open` are each \(0\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1-1299]

## Strategy
Audited source-30’s supplied full text, DOI `10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3`, by case-insensitive literal substring matching without word boundaries; thus `conjectured` at L978 counts for `conjecture`. The requested audit target is established. This audit does not establish Conjecture 4.10 beyond the source’s reported finite range.
